content: Melvin-Koushki recalls Jalāl al-Dīn Davānī's summary of the three levels of the letters: (1) spiritual-mental, the high or thought letters, which take form in the mind before being expressed and correspond to God's knowledge of realities before their coming into being; (2) oral, the medial letters, expressed in audible form; (3) written, the low letters, made visible to men of might and vision (Q 38:45).
